description: Jenkins automates repeatable project jobs. We will read small Jenkinsfile examples and learn stages, agents, parameters and clear results without setting up a production automation service. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain shell steps need the right agent

seo.title: Jenkins Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Jenkins with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
